name: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of printed circuit boards worldwide. Its products include high density interconnection, package substrates, and rigid-flex PCBs. The company offers its products for use in home appliances, including digital TVs and PCs; and mobile devices, such as mobile phones, memory modules, solid state drives, and LCD products, as well as PDAs and memory. Korea Circuit Co., Ltd. was founded in 1964 is headquartered in Ansan-Si, South Korea.
